beats.say: David Byrne turns game show host in Olivia Rodrigo's new video.
It is the visual for her Expectations remix featuring Chappell Roan.
The track comes from You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love.

lines: for a Girl So in Love

Did you spot David Byrne running the game show?
